roles.name: Shanker
powers: While you encounter an ally or bane, the difficulty of your Charisma and Diplomacy checks is increased by 1d8. You may evade allies and banes you encounter.

When you would fail a non-combat (☐ or combat) check against a bane, you may discard the top card of your deck to reroll the dice; take the new result. (☐ If the discarded card is a weapon, recharge it.)
On your check that invokes the Finesse trait, you gain the skill Melee: Dexterity +2 (☐ and if you are the only character at your location, you may recharge a card to add 1d6).
☐ Add 2 (☐ 4) to your check that has the Piercing trait.
☐ When you would discard a card that has the Knife or Sword trait for its power, you may recharge it (☐ or put it on top of your deck) instead.
☐ When you evade an encounter (☐ or defeat a monster), you may move.

roles.name: Master of Toads
powers: While you encounter an ally or bane, the difficulty of your Charisma and Diplomacy checks is increased by 1d8. You may evade allies and banes you encounter.
When you would fail a non-combat (☐ or combat) check against a bane, you may discard the top card of your deck (☐ or bury an ally that has the Pet trait) to reroll the dice; take the new result.

On your check that invokes the Finesse trait, you gain the skill Melee: Dexterity +2 (☐ and if you are the only character at your location, you may recharge a card to add 1d6) (☐ or 2d6 if the card has the Animal trait).
☐ Add 1d4 (☐ 2d4) to your check to acquire a boon that has the Animal trait.
☐ At the start (☐ or end) of your turn, you may examine the top card of a deck of a character at your location. If it has the Pet trait, you may draw it.
☐ You may put a card that has the Pet trait on top of your deck to examine the top card of another location deck. (☐ Then you may shuffle that location deck.)
